key: Goodness gracious, this is a tough crowd.
en: Goodness gracious, this is a tough crowd.
ja: やれやれ、なかなか手強い客ばかりだわ。

key: One guy checks in, says he'll be here for a month, and never shows up again.
en: One guy checks in, says he'll be here for a month, and never shows up again.
ja: ある人はチェックインして、1ヶ月はいるって言ったのに、それきり二度と現れない。

key: Another guy checks in for a day at a time, always insisting he'll be gone the next, but he hasn't missed one yet.
en: Another guy checks in for a day at a time, always insisting he'll be gone the next, but he hasn't missed one yet.
ja: 別の人は毎日1日ずつチェックインして、いつも明日には出ていくって言い張るのに、まだ一度も休んだことがない。
どうしてこんなに難しいのかしら。

key: Hello! Are you here to register for a room?
en: Hello! Are you here to register for a room?
ja: こんにちは! 部屋の登録に来ました?

key: Oh, you don't look homeless. Did your family lose their house recently?
en: Oh, you don't look homeless. Did your family lose their house recently?
ja: あら、あなたホームレスには見えないけど。最近、ご家族が家を失ったの?

key: Those are our main populations, and with all of the reconstruction, we've sure been full of 'em!
en: Those are our main populations, and with all of the reconstruction, we've sure been full of 'em!
ja: その二種類がうちの主な利用者で、この復興のせいで、本当に満室続きなのよ!
こんにちは、トレーナーさん!

key: Are you familiar with this building?
en: Are you familiar with this building?
ja: この建物、ご存じですか?

key: Of course! Anyone from Reborn City has probably seen it, but few knew what it really was.
en: Of course! Anyone from Reborn City has probably seen it, but few knew what it really was.
ja: もちろん! リボーンシティの人ならたいてい見たことがあるはずですが、それが本当は何なのか知っている人は少なかったんです。
それでよかったのかもしれません。

key: This place used to be a factory that produced lots of waste and harmed the environment.
en: This place used to be a factory that produced lots of waste and harmed the environment.
ja: ここは元々、大量の廃棄物を出して環境を傷つけていた工場だったんです。

key: When the construction began, the folks at the Grand Hall couldn't find an owner registration, so it was put up for sale.
en: When the construction began, the folks at the Grand Hall couldn't find an owner registration, so it was put up for sale.
ja: 工事が始まったとき、大ホールの人たちが所有者登録を見つけられなくて、売りに出されたんです。

key: Inspiration struck me, and I bought it to make it into a home for those in need of homes.
en: Inspiration struck me, and I bought it to make it into a home for those in need of homes.
ja: ふとひらめいて、住まいを必要としている人のための家にしようと、この場所を買い取りました。

key: I'm always happy to be able to serve my community, even if it was at a great cost.
en: I'm always happy to be able to serve my community, even if it was at a great cost.
ja: たとえ大きな犠牲を払っても、地域社会の役に立てるのはいつもうれしいことです。
